verdict.rationale: SendGrid's first-party docs describe an Event Webhook that posts email event data to a URL you control. They also describe an Inbound Parse webhook that sends parsed incoming email to a URL you choose. Both are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: detailed docs on event-type selection, payload schema, signature verification and retry behavior, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: To have Twilio SendGrid post email event data to a URL you control, add and configure an Event Webhook.
The Inbound Parse webhook parses the contents and attachments for incoming email to a email server, then send that data to a URL of your choice.
